method_note: Draft score combines position-adjusted value over replacement, mean season points, and simulated upside. Current depth-chart scenarios share each team's finite target, carry, pass-attempt, and touchdown budgets; rankings are not guarantees or injury reports.

validation.design: Architectures selected on 2024; final models refit through 2024; all 2025 weeks remain chronologically unseen.
limitations: Seen-week error is diagnostic only; model selection uses forward validation and promotion uses unseen weeks.
The holdout validates players who logged a game, not preseason availability or injury news.
Rookies and players with fewer than four prior games retain conservative simulation priors.
